sources.entry: Wakapi - Tracking tool for coding statistics, compatible with WakaTime. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Go/Docker

summary.one_liner: Wakapi is a minimalist, self-hosted, WakaTime-compatible backend that collects and displays coding statistics from WakaTime client tools.
summary.what_it_does: Wakapi receives heartbeat data from WakaTime client plugins and turns it into statistics for projects, languages, editors, hosts and operating systems. It offers a web UI, a REST API with Swagger docs, badges, weekly e-mail reports, and a public leaderboard. It can run with SQLite (default), MySQL/MariaDB, or Postgres via GORM. Authentication supports local accounts, OpenID Connect, API keys, and trusted reverse-proxy headers. It can export Prometheus metrics, forward heartbeats to WakaTime, import data from WakaTime or other Wakapi instances, and export raw heartbeats to CSV with a Python script.
use_cases: replace WakaTime with a self-hosted backend
view coding statistics by project or language
send coding stats to Prometheus and Grafana
embed coding stats badges or GitHub profile cards
how_to_run: docker run -d --init -p 3000:3000 -e "WAKAPI_PASSWORD_SALT=$SALT" -v wakapi-data:/data --name wakapi --restart unless-stopped ghcr.io/muety/wakapi:latest
curl -o wakapi.yml <config URL>  # then edit wakapi.yml
notable: WakaTime-compatible: works with the official WakaTime client tools by changing api_url and api_key in ~/.wakatime.cfg
Can forward heartbeats to WakaTime in parallel or import historic WakaTime data
Prometheus metrics export and weekly e-mail reports
Supports OpenID Connect, trusted reverse-proxy header auth, and invite-only registration
Data retention, inactivity cleanup, and a configurable public leaderboard
caveats: The README states the maintainers temporarily do not accept pull requests
Partially compatible with WakaTime and a smaller feature set (no team support, goals, or richer API, per the FAQ)
Trusted header authentication is described as prone to misconfiguration
keywords: see which languages i code in
